w_p1: YouGlish Downloader lets you find a phrase in YouTube speech, check its timing against the captions, and download just that clip.
w_p2: This installer puts YouGlish Downloader in your Applications folder and opens it. It takes less than a minute.
w_li1: Click Continue through the next screens, then Install. Your Mac asks for your password once.
w_li2: YouGlish Downloader opens by itself when it is done.
w_muted: Needs macOS 11 (Big Sur) or newer on a Mac with Apple silicon.
r_p: YouGlish Downloader reads captions and media from YouTube. Some videos open only for a signed-in viewer. Nothing is sent anywhere except to YouTube and YouGlish.
r_b_1: Open Account & Settings. Press 1. Sign in to Google, then 2. Connect YouTube.
r_b_2: Or choose your browser under Download authentication, to use a session you already have there.
r_b_3: Anonymous works for most public videos. Choose it if sign-in gives trouble.
r_o_1: Search a phrase, pick a sample, press Look Up, then Add to Download Queue.
r_end: Downloads are saved to the folder shown under Download settings.
c_p: YouGlish Downloader is in your Applications folder, and it is opening now.
c_open: Open Applications in Finder and double-click YouGlish Downloader.
c_trash_h: If your Mac can't move the installer to the Trash
c_trash: That happens when an earlier YouGlish-Downloader-Installer.dmg is already in the Trash. It's harmless: click OK, then delete YouGlish-Downloader-Installer.dmg from Downloads.
d_subtitle: YouGlish Downloader isn't from the App Store, so your Mac stops the installer once. To let it through:
d_step2: A message says it can't be opened. Click **Done** (not Move to Trash).
d_step3: Double-click the blue button below. In the page that opens, scroll to the bottom and click **Open Anyway**.
d_step4: Confirm with **Open Anyway** and your password. The installer opens: click **Continue**, then **Install**.
d_footnote: On macOS 13 or 14 it's quicker: right-click the installer, choose **Open**, then **Open** again.
